- Optimization

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Hi, been working on some improvements and fixes based on the latest feedback
Here's the changelog:

- Now it is possible to open and close containers with the same Key (F) by default
-Fixed not being allowed to move items with left shift + click to containers
- Added icon to the Rifle item
- Added more hot keys now there are 8 in total
- Fixed storage containers not allowing to store items in the last row
- Now leaving the car will place you by its side, and not on top of the car
- Added a new buildable called "Drop Resource Area" this will allow forcing the Survivor to drop resources on the given area (if there are more than one drop area he will choose a random one)
- Added a Flashlight and Battery to the starting area
- Changed Screws recipe to need Iron instead of Copper
- When stacking meat or other food items, it will use the average durability between the combined items
- Changed Flashlight key to 'L'
- Adjusted Flashlight light position

Thank you

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hi, been working on some improvements and fixes based on the latest feedback. Will be continuing to do it, so please keep posting. 
Here's the changelog:

- Now it's possible to cancel the current Survivor task
- Added a tutorial quest to explain on how to Save the game
- Changed the way item info is displayed when hovering an item in inventory, now it's displayed on the side and not in front of the hovered item
- Adjusted the position of the Player when entering a car
- Added Storage to the car
- Fixed a bug when igniting Campfire, it was choosing the wrong item as an example you choose the Lighter, and it still uses the Stone chance
- Fixed a bug preventing canceling a build
- Now when you cancel or dismantle a structure it will give back the items you use to build it
- Item hot bar and vital info are now displayed all the time
- Fixed MAP key bind showing TAB instead of M by default

The Survivor system will be reworked in the next update, it will be possible to manage the Survivors from a general menu, and the tasks will be improved to give the Player much more control. 
Also, the save system will be working much faster in the upcoming update.

Thank you
